features.title: Luxurious fabric upholstery for everyday comfort
features.text: Wrapped in premium, soft-touch fabric, the Windle sofa adds a cosy yet refined feel to your room, making it a perfect choice for quiet evenings or entertaining guests.

features.title: Adjustable cushions that fit your needs
features.text: The loose cushions are easily adjustable, allowing you to tailor the seating experience to your comfort—perfect for curling up with a blanket or sitting upright for chats.

features.title: Strong pinewood frame for lasting support
features.text: Built with a solid pinewood frame, this sofa delivers durability you can trust while keeping things lightweight and easy to move around.

features.title: Wooden details that make it stand out
features.text: The elegant wooden accents elevate the Windle’s design, adding just the right touch of charm to blend beautifully with modern or classic interiors.

features.title: Raised design for effortless upkeep
features.text: Raised sturdy legs make this sofa easy to clean underneath, ensuring your living space stays fresh and inviting without the hassle.
